sloka: तत् सर्वम् अखिलेन उक्तम् मम आख्येयम् अनादृतम् ।तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा दिशो जग्मुः तत् आज्ञया ॥१-५९-९॥
transliteration: tat sarvam akhilena uktam mama ākhyeyam anādṛtam ।tasya tat vacanam śrutvā diśo jagmuḥ tat ājñayā ॥1-59-9॥

translations.english: At his command the disciples set out in different directions. And as a result, expounders of the vedas began arriving from various countries.
